slice.note: A slice of Graphify's graph.json, not the whole file. Nodes and links are copied as Graphify wrote them.
slice.rule: Every node in a changed C# code file (unit test files left out), plus every function one 'calls' link away from a function in those files, plus every link between kept nodes.

adapter.note: Added by scripts/graphify-tieto.mjs, not by Graphify. Graphify gives a start line only; the end line is found by matching braces in the file at this commit.
